name: LetMeShip Next
description:
LetMeShip Next connects Claude to business shipping across Europe and worldwide. Ask for
a quote, compare carrier options side by side, create and book a shipment, pull the
label, and follow it to delivery — all in one conversation.

What you can do:
- Compare shipping options — rates, transit times and products from multiple carriers
  for parcels, documents and pallets, on any route
- Estimate duties and taxes for cross-border shipments before you commit, using HS
  codes and declared values
- Create a draft shipment with full customs detail — content lines, HS codes,
  incoterms, EORI and VAT numbers, importer address
- Add paid extras where the route needs them: insurance, truck or hydraulic tailgate
  delivery, scheduled pickup
- Book the draft once you've reviewed it, and get the PDF label back
- Track shipments by tracking number, with current status and full event history
- Search your shipment history — by date, carrier, country, status or your own reference

Built for businesses shipping parts, samples, machinery and high-value goods, where
picking the right carrier and getting the customs paperwork right actually matters.
Quoting and booking are deliberately separate steps: nothing is booked until you
confirm the draft.

Requires a (free) LetMeShip Next business account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LetMeShip Next to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LetMeShip Next to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://services.letmeship.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LetMeShip Next MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LetMeShip Next provides these MCP tools: book_shipment, calculate_admin_rates, compare_shipping_options, create_shipment_draft, estimate_duties_taxes, find_shipments, get_shipment_labels, track_shipment, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LetMeShip Next?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LetMeShip Next in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does LetMeShip Next MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: LetMeShip Next requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LetMeShip Next is developed by ITA Consulting GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
